about: Nalasopara East is a dense, fast-growing and highly affordable residential suburb on the Western Railway belt of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, anchored by the busy Tulinj and Achole roads and bordered by the Pelhar–Western Express Highway side. It sits between Vasai Road and Virar.

faq.question: What is Nalasopara East known for?
faq.answer: Nalasopara East is known for its very affordable high-density housing, the busy Tulinj Road and Achole Road belts, proximity to the Western Express Highway via Pelhar, and being one of the most populous and fast-growing railway-belt suburbs in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: Nalasopara East comes under pin code 401209, covering localities like Tulinj Road, Achole Road (east), Santosh Bhuvan East and Nilemore.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Nalasopara East are Tulinj Road, Achole Road (east), Santosh Bhuvan East, Nilemore, Pelhar and the highway-side belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: Property prices in Nalasopara East range from ₹22 lakh for a 1BHK near Nilemore/Pelhar to ₹36–52 lakh for a 2BHK on Tulinj Road and the Achole East belt, and ₹52–68 lakh for newer 2BHK projects near the highway side. Rental rates range from ₹6,000 to ₹14,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: Nalasopara East is served by Western Railway's Nalasopara station (between Vasai Road and Virar), with trains to Churchgate in about 65–80 minutes, plus VVMC and ST feeder buses, abundant auto rickshaws, and direct road access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48) via the Pelhar side and the upcoming Virar–Alibaug Multimodal Corridor.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Nalasopara East include Riddhi Vinayak Critical Care, Sai/Sparsh-style multispeciality hospitals, Cardinal Gracias Memorial Hospital (Vasai) and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Tulinj Road and Achole East belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Nalasopara East?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Nalasopara East include St. Lawrence High School, Podar/Universal-style English schools, Vidya Vikas High School and several CBSE and SSC schools serving the Tulinj Road and Santosh Bhuvan East area.
